# Planning Goal

## Goal
Build and deploy a personal blog website

## Constraints
- Must use static site generator
- Must support Markdown content
- Must deploy to Vercel
- Must be complete within 1 week
- Budget: $0 (free tier only)

## Dependencies
- Choose SSG framework (Hugo/Next.js/Astro)
- Set up content structure
- Configure deployment
- Write first 3 posts
